newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria sets April 3 to re-run some council polls.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria sets April 3 to re-run some council polls.

text.p: Nigeria is to re-run local council elections next Thursday in 139 areas out of 774 where similar polls held about two weeks ago were inconclusive, the electoral commission said.

It said in a statement in the capital Abuja on Wednesday that run-off elections would be held in 112 municipal councils where none of the five registered political parties gained an absolute majority.
By-elections will take place in the rest where results were not declared or were being disputed by the candidates.
Voting will take place in some areas where candidates who thought they had won were sworn into office on Monday by state military administrators.
"There were no winners in such areas and anyone sworn-in is just sworn-in for fun," Steve Osemeke, the spokesman of the electoral commission told reporters.
The elections were the first on a multi-party basis since the annulment of 1993 presidential poll which had been expected to restore democracy but was scrapped by the military.
A majority of the councils in the recent poll were won by two parties that have said they would like to adopt military ruler General Sani Abacha as their candidate in next year's presidential poll.
